$comment: Configuration read by the brd-analyst and jira-publisher agents. Replace every <<PLACEHOLDER>> once, commit, done. Values without << >> are working defaults. Both agents refuse to call tools with an unfilled <<...>> value.

issueTypes.$comment: Exact issue-type names in your project (getJiraProjectIssueTypesMetadata). Team-managed projects use "Subtask", company-managed "Sub-task".

fields.$comment: Ask brd-analyst: 'call getJiraIssueTypeMetaWithFields for project <KEY>, issue type Story, and list the field ids whose name contains Story point'. Story Points is customfield_10016 on most team-managed sites, customfield_10028/10024 on many company-managed sites — verify. acceptanceCriteria is optional: a custom-field id to ALSO receive the Gherkin AC (it is always written into the description).

jira.$comment_testCaseStrategy: subtask = one Sub-task per test under the story (works everywhere, default) | issue = separate issues of testIssueType (Xray 'Test' or Zephyr Squad; Zephyr Scale is NOT supported — its tests are not Jira issues) linked via createIssueLink with testLinkType, falls back to subtask | description = test-case table inside the story description
jira.calibrationJql: project = <<SFDC>> AND issuetype = Story AND statusCategory = Done AND resolved >= -180d ORDER BY resolved DESC

salesforce.$comment: Must be a SANDBOX alias created with `sf org login web -a dev-sandbox --instance-url https://<MyDomain>--<sandbox>.sandbox.my.salesforce.com` (test.salesforce.com only works if the sandbox's My Domain login policy allows it). Must match the --orgs value in .vscode/mcp.json. brd-analyst passes it as usernameOrAlias on every call and verifies Organization.IsSandbox before using org tools.

$comment_standardsFiles: Point these at your REAL Apex / Flow / LWC review instruction files (any path). .github/copilot-instructions.md and .github/instructions/**/*.instructions.md are always read in addition. Files still marked PLACEHOLDER make the analyst fall back to rubric defaults and cap confidence at M.

standardsOverheadPct.$comment: Sanity FLOOR, not the estimate: itemized standards tasks derived from the instruction files are authoritative; the analyst flags a story if itemized < pct or > 2x pct of the base defined in rubric §3.
